name: Rise Eboard Rentals (Play Bay Entertainment)
summary: Play Bay Entertainment, which trades online as Rise Eboard Rentals, runs a water sports base on Maxwell Coast Road in Christ Church, across from the Sun Bay Hotel. It rents Radinn electric surfboards and eFoils, which can be delivered to you, along with kayaks, paddle boards, Hobie Cat and Sunfish sailing, and towed and motorised water sports. Everything is booked online.
standouts: Radinn electric surfboards, up to 60 km an hour
Boost Fin electric propeller for paddle boards and surfboards
Electric surfboards and eFoils delivered to you for a $50 fee

contact.address: Maxwell Coast Road, Christ Church, Barbados (across from Sun Bay Hotel)

offers.text: Beach chair packages available with water sports

checkNotes: The operator's own site is a single home page of activity tiles; every activity links out to an Acuity scheduler (riseeboardrentals.as.me), and /water-sports redirects there too. Those pages are not the operator's own domain, so no prices, durations or times were read and every trip has prices []. The only phone shown is a WhatsApp link to +1 416 856 5328 (a Canadian number), plus a WhatsApp group invite; our list's +1 246 254 5328 is not on the site, so phone is null. Location on the site is Maxwell Coast Road, Christ Church, across from Sun Bay Hotel, not Speightstown as in our list; the site's live cam link points to a Paynes Bay camera run by another company. Fishing tours and luxury power boat coastal tours tiles link to other businesses' websites (barbadosfishingadventures.com, unseenbarbados.com) and were left out. The site also sells burgers (Rebell Burger Bar), sunscreen and beach toys. Activity tiles are mostly graphics, so trip images may be text-on-image tiles.
